author: Martin Champion-Jones
text: I use LibreLinkup with my SugarPixel and the guys there explained that it was purely a gateway with allowed you to pair with other devices using the cloud technology. It certainly works well for me and was easy to set up although I don't get the "not for treatment " statement as it is the same data as LibreLink.
